name: Flowise
description: Open source low-code tool for developers to build customized LLM orchestration flow and AI agents.

paths.name: Secrets Path
paths.description: Location where encryption key (used to encrypt/decrypt credentials) is saved

ports.name: HTTP Port
ports.description: The HTTP port Flowise runs on

variables.name: DATABASE_TYPE
variables.description: Type of database to store the flowise data

variables.name: DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: Location where database is saved (When DATABASE_TYPE is sqlite)

variables.name: DATABASE_HOST
variables.description: Host URL or IP address (When DATABASE_TYPE is not sqlite)

variables.name: DATABASE_PORT
variables.description: Database port (When DATABASE_TYPE is not sqlite)

variables.name: DATABASE_USER
variables.description: Database username (When DATABASE_TYPE is not sqlite)

variables.name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Database password (When DATABASE_TYPE is not sqlite)

variables.name: DATABASE_NAME
variables.description: Database name (When DATABASE_TYPE is not sqlite)

variables.name: DATABASE_SSL
variables.description: Database SSL is required (When DATABASE_TYPE is not sqlite)

variables.name: STORAGE_TYPE
variables.description: Type of storage for uploaded files. default is local

variables.name: BLOB_STORAGE_PATH
variables.description: Local folder path where uploaded files are stored when STORAGE_TYPE is local

variables.name: S3_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME
variables.description: Bucket name to hold the uploaded files when STORAGE_TYPE is s3

variables.name: S3_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: AWS Access Key

variables.name: S3_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: AWS Secret Key

variables.name: S3_STORAGE_REGION
variables.description: Region for S3 bucket

variables.name: SECRETKEY_PATH
variables.description: Location where encryption key (used to encrypt/decrypt credentials) is saved

variables.name: FLOWISE_USERNAME
variables.description: Username to login

variables.name: FLOWISE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password to login

variables.name: APIKEY_PATH
variables.description: Location where API keys are saved

variables.name: NUMBER_OF_PROXIES
variables.description: Rate Limit Proxy

variables.name: FLOWISE_FILE_SIZE_LIMIT
variables.description: Maximum file size when uploading

variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variables.description: The allowed origins for all cross-origin HTTP calls

variables.name: IFRAME_ORIGINS
variables.description: The allowed origins for iframe src embedding

variables.name: DISABLE_CHATFLOW_REUSE
variables.description: Disable caching the flow, allowing every interaction of the chatflow will be executed from scratch

variables.name: SHOW_COMMUNITY_NODES
variables.description: Display nodes that are created by community

variables.name: FLOWISE_SECRETKEY_OVERWRITE
variables.description: Encryption key to be used instead of the key stored in SECRETKEY_PATH

variables.name: MODEL_LIST_CONFIG_JSON
variables.description: Link to load list of models from your models.json config file
